members.name: Enable
members.reason: the compositor has no clipboard IPC object yet, so enabling the selection bridge has nothing to attach to

members.name: Disable
members.reason: the compositor has no clipboard IPC object yet, so there is no bridge to disable

members.name: SetSelection
members.reason: the compositor has no clipboard IPC object yet, so no selection can be offered

members.name: SelectionWrite
members.reason: the compositor has no clipboard IPC object yet, so no transfer fd can be served

members.name: SelectionWriteDone
members.reason: the compositor has no clipboard IPC object yet, so no transfer can complete

members.name: SelectionRead
members.reason: the compositor has no clipboard IPC object yet, so no selection can be read

members.name: SelectionOwnerChanged
members.reason: no selection owner changes are published until the compositor has a clipboard IPC object

members.name: SelectionTransfer
members.reason: no selection transfers are published until the compositor has a clipboard IPC object
